chunks_used.title: When to hand over to a human
chunks_used.text:
Hand over at once when any of these is true:

1. **Damaged, defective or wrong item worth more than ₹10,000.**
2. **Customer reports an order, payment or account activity they did not make.**
3. **Customer mentions legal action, a consumer court or a police complaint.**
4. **Third or later contact about the same issue within 7 days.**
5. **Refund more than 3 business days past its maximum timeline.**
6. **Customer asks for a human agent.**
7. **Product safety risk such as a swelling battery, burning smell, sparks or injury.**

For the repeat-contact rule, use the `contacts_last_7_days` field returned by order lookup. It counts earlier contacts only, not the current one. Escalate when it is 2 or more.

chunks_used.title: Never read out
chunks_used.text: Never read out the full phone number, email or street address, even to a verified customer.

chunks_used.title: Opening
chunks_used.text: Introduce yourself as ZentroMart's AI support assistant in your first reply.

chunks_retrieved.title: Grocery delivery slots
chunks_retrieved.text:
Grocery orders can be cancelled up to 2 hours before the start of the chosen delivery slot.
If the slot start time is not in the order record, ask the customer for the time shown in My Orders before confirming whether the cutoff has passed.

chunks_retrieved.title: Delivery times
chunks_retrieved.text:
| Delivery type | Metro cities | Other locations |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Standard | 3 to 6 business days | 5 to 9 business days |
| Express (selected pincodes) | Next business day if ordered before 2 pm, otherwise the business day after | Not available |

Each order shows a promised delivery date at checkout. That date is the commitment.

chunks_retrieved.title: Delivered but not received
chunks_retrieved.text: If an order shows Delivered but the customer has not received it, check with family, neighbours or the building security, then report it within 48 hours as a missing item under DWM-1.

chunks_retrieved.title: Booking
chunks_retrieved.text: Raise the return from My Orders. Choose a pickup slot. The delivery executive will check the item at the door against the condition rules in RET-4.

chunks_retrieved.title: Late deliveries
chunks_retrieved.text: If an **Express** order arrives after its promised date, the ₹79 express fee the customer paid is credited to ZentroMart Wallet automatically within 48 hours. ZentroMart Plus members, who pay no express fee, get no credit. There is no compensation for late Standard deliveries. Agents must not offer any other compensation.

chunks_retrieved.title: Before the order ships
chunks_retrieved.text: Any order can be cancelled free of charge until it is shipped, by the customer from My Orders in the app. The support assistant cannot cancel orders itself; it guides the customer to My Orders. The refund is initiated immediately.
